e7_s4_rejected.label: Staphylococcal biofilm infection
e7_s4_rejected.why: While Staphylococcus epidermidis is a common cause of biofilm infections, the presentation of a localized lesion over the implant site is more consistent with a pocket infection.

e7_s4_rejected.why: This is a broad term that could apply, but the specific involvement of the pacemaker pocket and the growth of Staphylococcus epidermidis make pacemaker pocket infection a more specific diagnosis.
